title: Visit Alhambra
text:
Space is the representation of ideas.
If you look at the Alhambra and don’t have a guide by your side, you only see a garden, a series of buildings, some from one era, others from another.
If your guide is called Gianluca dell agency Visit Granada you understand and if you understand you will remember the flowers, plants and everything that has shaped those places over time. Learning passes through the word, only if it is offered to you with passion and competence, you pay attention, only then the desire to understand is kindled in you and you do not stand by. 
Thank you.
author: Dreamer45861725390

title: Gianluca Befanile driving for Granada
text: We did several tours through Civitatis in Seville and Granada, but the difference is the guide!!!! In Seville Spanish guides speaking Italian, seemed to read the lesson without patos or involvement of exhausted participants after delay and non-working headphones. In Granada, it took a true, Neapolitan Italian, Gianluca Befanile to visit the Alhambra with historical anecdotes, professional expertise and that sympathy and empathy that only Neapolitans can transmit. title: All lovely

author: fabianac366

title: Guida beats Palazzos 1 to 0
text: The Alhambra has a reputation for great attention, but without the sultan's palaces, I was already a little disappointed, and instead Gianluca's guide took me through the visit. Competent, cheerful, ironic and very helpful. Don't worry, it's worth the cost! Great Gianluca!
author: gianpaolog249

title: Unforgettable
text:
Visit carried out with Gianluca, an Italian guide, conducted in a perfect manner with a broad explanation of the monuments both from an architectural and historical point of view, furthermore Gianluca provided us with several files to delve deeper into some aspects.
The beauty of the Alhambra site did the rest, an unforgettable visit
author: mauroaI3076XD

title: Fantastic weekend in Granada
text: Granada is beautiful, the friendly people and the excellent food, the Alhambra is a wonder experienced to the full thanks to our super guide Gianluca... he made us experience the various historical and temporal passages time by time in an intense and fun way... three hours of unique history, culture, art
